'''Sir William Brinton''' is an [[ally]].  He first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Science Building]].

==Card info==
*+1 Maximum [[Stamina]]

Discard to immediately restore your Stamina to its maximum.

==Mythos Source==
Sir William Brinton appears in ''The Rats in the Walls'' (1923), written by H.P. Lovecraft.
